PiG renders Markdown with its own Go parser in tui/markdown*.go and exposes no marked-shaped parser or token types, so there is no Go declaration to port. Designed out as a third-party re-export, as the ai typebox re-exports (Static, TSchema, Type) are.

Go's interface additionally requires ViewportTop and IsFollowingOutput, which Pi's ViewportTUI does not.
